modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ls_tweaks: Quality-of-life tweaks for inventory management, sorting, and auto-refill.
config.ls_tweaks.refill_enabled.tooltip: Automatically refill hotbar stacks from your inventory.
config.ls_tweaks.refill_strictNbt.toolti: Only refill with items that match NBT/components (enchants, names, data).
config.ls_tweaks.refill_includeFood.tool: Also refill edible items when consumed.
config.ls_tweaks.refill_includeProjectil: Also refill arrows, snowballs, pearls, and similar throwables.
config.ls_tweaks.refill_workOnContainerS: Allow auto-refill while a container screen is open.
config.ls_tweaks.sorting_enabled.tooltip: Enable inventory and container sorting features.
config.ls_tweaks.sorting_unstackablesLas: Place unstackable items at the end in Category mode.
config.ls_tweaks.sorting_allowContainerS: Enable sorting for containers that are whitelisted by datapacks.
message.ls_tweaks.sorting.inventory_only: Open your inventory (R) or use Shift+R in a container.
